error.missing_view_filter_name: The view filter {$count} must have the `name` option defined as a non-empty string.
error.invalid_view_filter_no_condition: The view filter {$count} must have the `pattern` option or a comparison option such as `eq` or `gte` to match entries against.
error.invalid_view_filter_name: The view filter name `{$name}` is invalid. It must not contain special characters.
error.duplicate_view_filter_name: View filter names must be unique, but `{$name}` is used more than once.
error.invalid_view_group_default: The `default` option of `view_groups` is set to `{$name}`, but no view group has that name.
error.invalid_view_filter_default: The `default` option of `view_filters` is set to `{$name}`, but no view filter has that name.

error.invalid_collection_name: The collection name `{$name}` is invalid. It must not contain special characters.
error.duplicate_collection_name: Collection names must be unique, but `{$name}` is used more than once.

error.invalid_collection_file_name: The collection file name `{$name}` is invalid. It must not contain special characters.
error.duplicate_collection_file_name: Collection file names must be unique, but `{$name}` is used more than once.

error.collection_file_no_fields: The collection file must have the `fields` option defined with at least one field.
error.collection_folder_i18n_required: The collection must have the `i18n` option defined if the `locale` placeholder is used in the `folder` path.
error.invalid_collection_folder_locale: The `folder` path `{$folder}` is invalid. The `locale` placeholder must be used only once as a whole folder name, like `content/\{\{locale\}\}/posts`.
error.collection_file_i18n_required: The collection file must have the `i18n` option defined if the `locale` placeholder is used in the `file` path.
error.missing_field_name: The field {$count} must have the `name` option defined as a non-empty string.
error.invalid_field_name: The field name `{$name}` is invalid. It must not contain special characters. If you want to nest fields, use Object fields instead of dot notation.
error.duplicate_field_name: Field names must be unique, but `{$name}` is used more than once.
error.missing_variable_type: The variable type {$count} must have the `name` option defined as a non-empty string.
error.invalid_variable_type: The variable type name `{$name}` is invalid. It must not contain special characters.
error.duplicate_variable_type: Variable type names must be unique, but `{$name}` is used more than once.
error.date_field_type: The deprecated Date field type is not supported in Sveltia CMS. Use the DateTime field type with the `type: date` option instead.
error.invalid_timezone: Invalid timezone: {$timeZone}. Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier like `America/New_York` or `Asia/Tokyo`.
error.unsupported_deprecated_option: The deprecated `{$prop}` option is not supported in Sveltia CMS. Use the `{$newProp}` option instead.

error.invalid_range_options: The `{$min}` option must not be greater than the `{$max}` option.
error.invalid_step: The `step` option is set to `{$step}`, but it must be greater than zero.

error.invalid_default_multiple: The `default` option must be an array because the `multiple` option is `true`.
error.invalid_default_single: The `default` option must be a single value, not an array, because the `multiple` option is not `true`.
error.object_field_invalid_default_key: The Object field’s `default` option has the `{$key}` property, but no subfield has that name.

error.code_field_invalid_default_object: The Code field’s `default` option must be a string because the `output_code_only` option is `true`.
error.code_field_invalid_default_key: The Code field’s `default` option has the `{$key}` property, but the `keys` option only allows `{$code}` and `{$lang}`.
error.number_field_default_not_integer: The Number field’s `default` option is set to `{$value}`, but it must be an integer because the `value_type` option is `{$valueType}`.
error.number_field_default_not_number: The Number field’s `default` option is set to `{$value}`, but it must be a number because the `value_type` option is `{$valueType}`.
error.object_field_no_subfields: The Object field’s `fields` or `types` option must have at least one item.
error.relation_field_invalid_collection: The referenced `{$collection}` collection is invalid or not defined.
error.relation_field_invalid_collection_file: The referenced `{$file}` file is invalid or not defined.
error.relation_field_missing_file_name: The `file` option must be defined for a relation to a file collection.
error.relation_field_invalid_value_field: The referenced value field `{$field}` is invalid or not defined.
error.relation_field_array_file_slug: The relation to the `{$collection}` collection can’t store the `\{\{slug\}\}` value, as an entry’s slug in a collection with the `file` option is its position, which changes when the entries are reordered or deleted. error.relation_field_invalid_display_field: The referenced display field `{$field}` is invalid or not defined.
error.relation_field_invalid_search_field: The referenced search field `{$field}` is invalid or not defined.
error.relation_field_invalid_filter_field: The referenced filter field `{$field}` is invalid or not defined.
error.schema_invalid_enum: The `{$option}` option must be one of these values: {$values}.
error.schema_invalid_empty_value: The `{$option}` option must be an empty string.
error.schema_invalid_item_count: The `{$option}` option must be an array of {$count} items.

error.schema_missing_one_of: One of these options is required: {$options}.
